title: How to find the latest (or earliest) date in a range
task: Most recent activity, newest entry, next deadline — dates are numbers, so MAX and MIN do it.

excel.note: Format the result cell as a date. MIN gives the earliest; MAXIFS adds conditions.

explanation: Dates are day-count serials underneath, so the biggest number is the latest date — the verification's serials decode to July 1, June 15, and August 6, 2026, and MAX correctly picks August 6. The per-entity version is MAXIFS: =MAXIFS(A:A,B:B,"cust-42") finds a customer's most recent order. If MAX returns 0 or a 1899 date, the column is text-dates — convert them first (see the convert-text-to-date recipe).
